definitions_source: NASA/TP-2015-216046 (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20150023456), Appendix A.1 and Table IX

columns.burning_rate_constant_mm2_s: average burning-rate constant from a linear fit of droplet diameter squared vs time (mm^2/s)
columns.x_o2 / x_n2 / x_co2 / x_he: ambient mole fractions; PSI CSV headers 'O', 'N', 'CO', 'He' are O2, N2, CO2, He
columns.group_test_date: test date; tests on the same day share a chamber fill and setup, so a whole day is kept in one partition

label_rule.Disruption: excluded (the burn ended by droplet break-up)
